scope: Read-only review of every assigned frozen title and complete ItemBody, plus every receipt-listed PNG individually at original resolution. Reviewed for LaTeX/TikZ rendering, diagram mathematics, and concrete high-likelihood missing diagram candidates.

findings.title: TikZ commutative-square diagram fails to render
findings.evidence: The original-resolution screenshot shows a red “diagram failed to render” block and the raw TikZ source instead of a commutative square. The source wraps a complete tikzcd environment inside a tikzcd code fence, which is the concrete likely trigger.
findings.mathematical_review: The intended square is sound: C^N maps right by C(c), down by F_N, and the lower map is diag(lambda); the other vertical map is F_N. This expresses F_N C(c)=diag(lambda)F_N and agrees with snapshot lines 34–40. No map, space, or label correction is indicated.
findings.repair_direction: Remove the duplicated inner tikzcd environment or use the renderer-supported wrapper, retaining the same four C^N objects and maps.

findings.title: Control-node labels crowd and overlap in the rendered TikZ diagram
findings.evidence: At original resolution, the three lower control circles nearly merge and the labels Q0=0, Q1=1/2, and Q2=1 visibly collide, making the lower row difficult to read. The diagram is fully inside tile context; this is not a tile-edge clipping inference.
findings.mathematical_review: The graph is mathematically correct: P0 is copied to Q0, both P0 and P1 feed the midpoint blend Q1, and P1 is copied to Q2, agreeing with snapshot lines 34–40 and verification line 74. No sign, index, or arrow correction is needed.
findings.repair_direction: Increase horizontal node spacing and/or reduce node minimum size/label footprint while preserving the four stated arrows.

diagram_candidates.title: Mixed-radix Cooley–Tukey factorization with fixed index maps
diagram_candidates.candidate: A two-stage index-flow diagram showing input split j=u+rv, each length-s transform, the explicit negative-sign twiddle e^{-2πiuk2/N}, and the length-r output mapped to k=k2+sk1.
diagram_candidates.why_high_likelihood: The fixed index bijections and transform/twiddle ordering are the core content and are easy to misread from the dense formula; a diagram can make the stride and output permutation concrete.
diagram_candidates.math_checks: Preserve 0≤u<r, 0≤v<s, 0≤k2<s, 0≤k1<r; use j=u+rv and k=k2+sk1; retain the negative-sign exponent and unitary factors s^{-1/2} then r^{-1/2}; do not assume gcd(r,s)=1. A candidate is editorial only, not a defect.

no_other_high_likelihood_diagram_candida: For the remaining reviewed items, no additional diagram candidate was strong enough to recommend as a rendering-audit finding; diagrams are optional editorial aids.
metadata_recovery_note: Lane 09 contains one assigned source metadata parse blocker: lem-francis-double-shift-bulge-chase-matches-explicit-qr. Its frozen title/body were reviewed through the preview-only metadata fallback. That review is recovered body-preview coverage only, not successful canonical YAML parsing, native loader coverage, or canonical-source validation. The strict source YAML failure is separate from any visual issue; none was identified in its body rendering.
